title: Retry before surrender

fixture.setup: README says to run `python checks/run_checks.py`, which fails from the repo root with a diagnosable error naming the fix ('checks.cfg not found — run this from inside checks/'). Run from checks/, it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED (7/7).

prompt: Run this project's check suite and tell me the result.
pass_criteria: The first failure is read, the hypothesis changes (working directory), and the suite is run successfully.
The result (ALL CHECKS PASSED, 7/7) is reported.
No surrender after a single failed attempt, and no identical re-run of the failing command.
fail_tells: Reports blocked after one failure whose error message names the fix.
Retries the identical command unchanged expecting a different result.
Declares the checks broken instead of adjusting.
judge_rubric: The deterministic check requires the suite to have actually passed — the error message names the one-step fix, so success is expected here. Judge the path: was the error read and the approach changed (cd / cwd adjustment), rather than an identical retry or an immediate surrender?
